content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Digital India Corporation has advertised a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Backend Developer position on a contract or consolidated basis for the Academic Bank Of Credits project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification and key requirements to be eligible for the post of Junior Backend Developer. Key Requirements: Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience writing Python jobs for large-scale data processing. At least 3 years of experience working with PHP and PHP-based frameworks. More than 1 year of experience utilizing AWS components within container-based applications. Solid knowledge and understanding of Scrum and Agile Development practices. Demonstrates strong ownership, responsibility, and leadership qualities with a consistently positive attitude. Strong desire to collaborate and help others resolve complex technical problems and issues. Ability to multitask effectively and manage multiple high-priority projects and commitments concurrently. Exceptional time-management skills with a proven track record of working efficiently under tight pressure and deadlines. rows.essential_qualification: B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA or any Equivalent Degree with excellent analytical and software development skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration commensurate with qualifications and experience within the approved project norms. The position is purely temporary in nature for the project of Digital India Corporation.

content_sections.heading: DIC Junior Backend Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: The core responsibilities assigned to the Junior Backend Developer include: Develop highly restful, scalable APIs and deploy robust microservices onto the AWS ecosystem. Architect and write optimized Python-based backend scripts tailored for processing large volumes of data. Continuously maintain, review, and optimize code quality to ensure long-term application scalability and performance. Successfully manage, mentor, and lead a technical team of at least 2 developers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIC Junior Backend Developer
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/. Complete the online application form with the required details. Submit the application online on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting shall be carried out through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, certifications, publications, and other criteria as approved by the Competent Authority. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for selection interviews. Digital India Corporation reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening and limiting the number of candidates for interview.
